commits.summary: Record the setup for the receiver construction and property discovery brief
commits.body:
A setup session pinned and checked every input the brief and its cases name, before the domain work starts. The pinned revisions are JavaParser 360 and CSV 366 (parent and fix), Commons Configuration 565 and 601 and Commons Compress 767 (old and new sides), and JGraphT 1.5.2, XZ 1.11 and 1.12, Guava 33.4.8 and Lang 3.17.0. Each is a worktree from a bare mirror; the XZ tags are signature-checked. The released graphs were resolved from Maven Central with strict checksums, and all 20 signatures are valid (JGraphT's key has since expired). The JGraphT, Guava and Lang jars match the brief's SHA-256 values. The earlier receiver campaign's area and Maven cache were checked (586 classpath files, none changed) and hard-link snapshotted. JBMC 6.11.0 and the JDK Arrays.class match the brief's digests, and the checker's release binary is current at this head.

Every JVM observation the brief states for an existing library or fixture reproduced exactly on Temurin 21.0.13. That covers the Checkout and SafetySites controls (offsets 19/21/44/54 and the mode > 3 mutant), CSV a||b|| parent against fix, the four registered Configuration observations on all four sides, the 767 frames, the XZ cache profiles on 1.11 and 1.12, the JavaParser traversals and the cleared line.separator, the JGraphT census (25 graphs, 150 transitions: 48/48/54) and identity control, Guava's 131,072-string agreement, and the Commons Lang witness bits. The landed regressions of #218 and #4538 are on record from runs at the same commits. No claims, examples or adapters were written, the verifier and JBMC were not run, and no verification job was needed. Everything fetched lives under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/receiver-construction.
